name: embedded-assets
body: Only the core of the tool is embedded via Go `embed` and served from the binary: reveal.js (pinned to release 6.0.2, MIT) and the core page shells (deck page, full-page error page, /templates gallery page), plus the minimal `kalide init` seed (see cli-init-minimal-seed). These are core to the tool, not templates or assets. reveal.js is vendored from the release package's `dist/` directory into `internal/assets/reveal/` and committed there together with its `LICENSE`; no `npm install`, no build step. No templates, themes, fonts, logos, starter decks or other media are embedded: every project supplies its own template library, either a local `templates/` or a configured external path (see project-templates, external-template-library). AC: `internal/assets` embeds no templates/, fonts/, logo/, starter/ or theme.css; no embedded asset or page shell carries a brand name, font or logo (global.constraint.core-unbranded); the core page shells style only via the project theme's stylesheet.
